newsitem.title: EGYPT: SAIB doubling size of Egyptian fund.
newsitem.headline: SAIB doubling size of Egyptian fund.

text.p: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque (SAIB) said on Sunday it was doubling the size of its Egyptian mutual fund to 100 million pounds ($29.4 million).
The net asset value of the fund, managed by Prime Investments, has risen 30.6 percent since its launch in June 1996 with a maximum size of 50 million pounds.
It is one of the best performing of Egypt's 12 mutual funds, second only to the Delta fund, which has gained 44 percent since it was launched in August.
SAIB said the Capital Market Authority had approved the increase in the size of the fund and the bank will offer from Sunday 200,000 new units at the current market price.
The units, which have a nominal value of 500 pounds, were priced at 653.15 pounds on December 26.
Egypt's mutual funds, all launched since August 1994, now have a total market value of 2.113 billion pounds. The annual returns since launch vary from 15.5 to 109.6 percent.
